name: sinu-stuudium
description: Sinu Stuudiumi jagatud kujundus ning Chromiumi brauserilaiendus.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-theme.mjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names theme,extension "node scripts/watch-theme.mjs" "wxt -b chrome"
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build:mobile:web && npm run validate:mobile:web && node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs :app:assembleRelease
scripts.validate:android: npm run build:mobile:web && npm run validate:mobile:web && node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs :app:lintDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug
scripts.package: npm run build && wxt zip -b chrome && node scripts/validate-package.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run check:theme && npm run check:mobile:web && npm run validate:mobile:web && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run validate:build
